method: Strict read-only archive reconstruction, immutable source hash matching, pinned input index and original anchor/point verification, archived cloud_startup_timing, cloud_cycle timestamps and Actions job metadata.

comparison.gap_definition: old cloud_cycle finished to first new cloud_cycle started, within same open session

outer_timings.queue_overlap_note: 16 seconds overlaps old-job tail; do not add it again to total interruption. Queue versus runner allocation individually unmeasured.

restore_path.evidence: Matched archived cloud_bundle/cloud_archive/source hashes, positive restore_point_verify_seconds, fixed checkpoint index before new job, point manifest/chunk/payload hash checks and original-anchor match, subsequent successful natural cycles.
restore_path.interpretation: All retained original package bytes, hashes, lineage and BLOBs are checked; prefix snapshots are not reconstructed one generation at a time. Compact snapshot and original anchor are verified once, then only generations 968 and 969 replay. chain_verify_seconds=4.811998 is the seeded-cache/tail phase, not full legacy-prefix replay.
restore_path.input_commit_limitation: Startup timing event lacks an explicit input-commit field. Input index is pinned using the last checkpoint before the job, with no intervening private commit before the first new cycle; this inference is corroborated by immutable ancestry and source path.

observed_variants.variant: Oct22 afternoon subsequent compact cold handoff

next_repair_proposals.scope: Add finer read-only restore diagnostics in cloud_checkpoint/cloud_bundle/cloud_archive and tests
next_repair_proposals.evidence: 272.613341 seconds (58.55% of restore) is currently one combined package-read bucket. It includes repeated bounded reads and checks; Git transfer, HEAD/fetch checks, cat-file extraction and file writes are not individually timed.
next_repair_proposals.proposal: Record initial fetch separately; number/bytes/time of bounded read batches, HEAD/confirm/fetch, object decode/write, gzip/JSON, BLOB validation, canonical hashing, SQLite and first-cycle persistence. Do not log private payloads or credentials.
next_repair_proposals.expected_improvement: Measurement first; no speed estimate claimed.

next_repair_proposals.scope: Optimize repeated checkpoint confirmation/object reads within a pinned cold-restore read session
next_repair_proposals.evidence: Archived code reads batches of 16 files; read_files calls confirm, remote HEAD and fetch repeatedly. Package read increased from morning 186.228519 to 272.613341 seconds; causal time split is not measured.
next_repair_proposals.proposal: After profiling, evaluate byte-bounded batches and reuse immutable Git objects within the same pinned read transaction, retaining repository/account binding, all content hashes, before/after HEAD conflict detection and every pre-trade persistence barrier.
next_repair_proposals.expected_improvement: Reduced redundant network/process overhead is a hypothesis; magnitude requires same-pinned-input comparison. Do not claim all 272.61 seconds removable.

next_repair_proposals.scope: Reduce repeated original-package parsing during compact anchor validation
next_repair_proposals.evidence: Compact verification still costs 144.969606 seconds (31.13%); all historical BLOBs remain sourced from original packages.
next_repair_proposals.proposal: Profile gzip/JSON, BLOB validation and canonical hash separately; test bounded streaming/reuse of already verified immutable decoded data within one restore. Keep all history and exact hash/count/lineage checks; no cross-job trust of unverified caches.
next_repair_proposals.expected_improvement: Potential CPU/I/O savings, unmeasured. No proposal to skip historical integrity checks.

verification_deployment_rollback.tests: Pinned legacy and v2 snapshots must restore byte/logically equivalent state; all package/point/anchor/tail corruption, reordered history, hash/count mismatch, changed HEAD, account mismatch and cache tampering must fail closed. Full unittest suite, no broker calls. Benchmark identical cold inputs with component timers and memory/bytes recorded.
verification_deployment_rollback.deployment: A separately tested reviewed code-only release to existing main, non-force; existing workflow/schedule/concurrency unchanged. Wait for next natural handoff and compare old-finish to new-start and new-finish; require successful cycles and complete archives before acceptance.
verification_deployment_rollback.rollback: Revert only the new performance changes to reviewed ccfaa10 through a new non-force commit; preserve v2 compatibility, all archives, core risk/order state and history; next natural job loads rollback. Never reset state or start another executor.
verification_deployment_rollback.current_action: Diagnosis and proposal only; no further trading-code change published in this inspection.

limitations: One actual afternoon cold handoff demonstrates reduction; no guaranteed future startup time or zero downtime.

Latest core is ahead of the fully reconstructed archive: archive completes through 15:29:05 ET, latest core 15:31:09 ET. Historical handoff and 34 following cycles are fully archived; missing later evidence is not invented.
Package-read subphases, compact-validation subphases and first-cycle broker/persistence split remain unmeasured.
Job/commit metadata have one-second resolution; cycle timestamps and monotonic phase timers have finer precision.
Observed protective stops do not establish continuous coverage between snapshots.
Cloud startup is independent of GPT; chat audits/publication still require the desktop app.
peer_questions: Can you independently review the pinned-read transaction proposal for changed-HEAD fail-closed behavior and bounded memory without relaxing any order barrier?
strategy_research: No new strategy experiment or candidate promotion; this is an operations measurement.
fees_and_fills: No simulated performance or synthetic fills used; no trading-profit claim, fee assumption or capital reuse change.
